name: Good Night, Peregrine
source:
A short experimental visual novel where you spend time with the titular Perry, a shut in recluse gamer, and his friends.
Meet a colorful cast of characters in a strange world much like our own.
Learn and explore secrets from the past.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2181990/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
这是一款短篇实验性视觉小说，你将与标题中的主角Perry——一名足不出户的孤僻玩家——及他的朋友们共度时光。
在一个与现实相似却又奇异的世界里，结识一群个性鲜明的角色。
了解并探索过去的秘密。

[来源：[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2181990/]Steam[/url]]
